instruction: A full violin rendered as a leaded stained-glass mosaic, its curved body pieced from amber, ruby, and cobalt glass panels. Dark soldered leading traces the f-holes, scroll, and four strings, glowing as if backlit by warm light. The elegant hourglass silhouette stands upright, each colored shard casting jeweled tones across its surface.
